title: Surviving the Singularity: original publication motifs
authoring: Original geometry authored for this publication; no tracing, external fonts or embedded assets.

assets.title: Grain and an open gripper
assets.description: A curved ear of grain meets the open fingers of an articulated machine.

assets.title: An uncertain horizon
assets.description: Curved orbital lines pass around an open circular center; a speculative astronomical metaphor.

assets.title: A centrifugal governor
assets.description: Two weighted arms, a sliding collar and a spindle suggest regulation and feedback.

assets.title: A seed becoming a plant
assets.description: A small seed opens into paired leaves and a branching root system across the ground line.

assets.title: A roof and its joint
assets.description: Open timber framing emphasizes the roof's supporting joints rather than a finished property.

assets.title: A shared table
assets.description: An oval table holds distinct bowls and a small stem, with seats around its open perimeter.

assets.title: A stitched pamphlet
assets.description: An open, hand-stitched pamphlet shows its folds and thread, without simulated writing.

assets.title: A pump and its water
assets.description: A hand-operated pump with a curved lever releases water above a small, open ripple.

assets.title: Repair tools and a loose washer
assets.description: An open-ended wrench, a screwdriver and a loose washer make a small working still life.

assets.title: Roots and a depth probe
assets.description: A root system and an unnumbered three-level probe cross an uneven soil section.

assets.title: A route and an alternative
assets.description: Two routes through contoured ground join the same endpoints; one has a visible break.

package_note: Only referenced motifs are bundled. Cover artwork is assets/cover-art.svg.
